main.description: An account's reposts of posts by accounts this AppView serves for a listed community, newest first, as feed items whose reason is app.bsky.feed.defs#reasonRepost (by the actor). Any account, served for a listed community or not. A repost whose post or reposter cannot be shown is left out; a visitor blocked either way by the actor gets an empty feed.

servedAs.description: The form this answer was served in: `member` (a ready member, with its stored viewer state) or `visitor` (anyone else).

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: Profile not found: the actor does not resolve, or the account is deleted.
